definitionZh: CSS说明内容属性定义了浏览器如何沿弹性容器主轴和网格及多曲线容器内置轴在内容项目之间和周围分配空间.
sourceDefinition: The CSS justify-content property defines how the browser distributes space between and around content items along the main axis of a flex container and the inline axis of grid and multicol containers.
